checkpoint_training_corpus.author_declared_content: human lentiMPRA sequence-to-expression measurements from K562, HepG2, and WTC11
checkpoint_training_corpus.cross_validation: ten-fold training and testing in the author study
checkpoint_training_corpus.exact_checkpoint_fold: test1_val2 inferred from filename; training receipt unavailable
checkpoint_training_corpus.warning: The exact Hugging Face bytes have not been shown to equal one checkpoint inside the author Zenodo release.

endpoint_eligibility.allelic_direction_accuracy: eligible as a HepG2 MPRA diagnostic after allele and sequence-construction fixtures pass
endpoint_eligibility.enhancer_gene_link_retrieval: ineligible without a separately frozen link model
endpoint_eligibility.eqtl_retrieval_auprc: component_only after a separately frozen variant-to-gene mapping
endpoint_eligibility.mean_fisher_z_celltype_spearman: ineligible standalone because the score has neither a target gene nor cell-type eQTL/ieQTL calibration
endpoint_eligibility.typed_evidence_graph: reporter-activity edge only; never an endogenous enhancer-gene edge

gse281364.allowed_use: Frozen zero-shot HepG2 reporter-activity and direction diagnostic. Any learned head must be out-of-fold by merged locus, sequence identity, and reverse-complement identity. Control and PAOA receive the same sequence score; LX-2 is out of native domain.
gse281364.reason: The exact Hugging Face revision predates the GEO release and its declared corpus is the earlier K562/HepG2/WTC11 lentiMPRA study.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time sequence-only inference after selection lock. Only evaluator-approved variant coordinates and alleles may enter the sequence builder; no eQTL/ieQTL effect, retrieval label, lineage result, threshold, or calibration value may be exposed.
gse289173.reason: The exact output file was uploaded after the GEO release, but the output file declares only HepG2 lentiMPRA training and no MASLD cohort labels. This is not a clean chronology claim.

gse296875.allowed_use: Training-fold-only nomination of peaks or loci for development diagnostics. Held-donor ATAC, pathology, RNA, peak calls, or normalization cannot select windows, heads, thresholds, or calibration.
gse296875.reason: The exact output file was uploaded ten days after the GEO release but declares an unrelated lentiMPRA corpus. Exact developer exposure is not established, so only target-label unexposed is claimed.

missingness_and_topology.gse281364: RNA and DNA barcode counts are same-sample different aliquots. Four assay replicates per context are not independent donors. Missing oligo joins, alleles, or contexts are explicit missing states, never zero activity.
missingness_and_topology.gse289173: RNA and QTL summaries are same-study unpaired. The checkpoint consumes sequence only and produces no donor-conditioned output.
missingness_and_topology.gse296875: Same-nucleus RNA-ATAC pairing is not used by MPRALegNet. Donor identity still governs every development split.

split_and_leakage_rules.donor_rule: All GSE296875 nuclei from one donor remain in one outer fold; cells and nuclei are not biological replicates.
split_and_leakage_rules.genomic_rule: Merge variants by native-build LD, locus, exact sequence, and reverse-complement identity before splitting. Apply a 230-bp boundary buffer.
split_and_leakage_rules.head_rule: GSE281364 can fit only an assay-native MPRA activity or direction head and every scored locus must be out-of-fold. It cannot fit a signed eQTL/ieQTL head.
split_and_leakage_rules.sealed_rule: No layer, orientation rule, checkpoint choice, sequence construction, target-gene mapper, threshold, or calibration can change after sealed outcomes are opened.
